high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures two women standing together in what appears to be an outdoor dining or event space. The setting is characterized by a large tent structure with a transparent roof supported by metal beams, allowing natural light to filter through. The background reveals several round tables set for a meal, each adorned with tablecloths, plates, glasses, and floral centerpieces, suggesting a formal or semi-formal gathering. The woman on the left is dressed in a pinstriped suit with a blazer and matching pants, paired with white shoes.
